programs.title: Santa Fe
programs.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. Four brothers leave the defeated South to seek jobs as the US recovers from the Civil War. As one becomes a railwayman, the others turn to crime.

programs.title: Apache Drums
programs.desc: Stephen McNally stars as a gunslinger who gets slung out of town for gambling too well, but the town might just need him soon in Hugo Fregonese's visually arresting western.

programs.title: The Land Girls
programs.desc: Moving Second World War drama starring Catherine McCormack, Rachel Weisz and Anna Friel as young women who volunteer to be agricultural workers and fall for the farmer's son.

programs.title: Erin Brockovich
programs.desc: Fact-based legal drama. Julia Roberts won an Oscar, Golden Globe and BAFTA for her portrayal of a single mum making a huge impact at a legal firm despite having no formal training.

programs.title: Bombshell
programs.desc: Drama with Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman and Margot Robbie. Three Fox News employees fight to expose the inappropriate behaviour of a media mogul (John Lithgow).

programs.title: Hear My Song
programs.desc: Unashamedly romantic comedy starring Ned Beatty as Josef Locke, a 1950s singer with a voice that makes women weep... in a good way. Co-starring Adrian Dunbar.

programs.title: Reap the Wild Wind
programs.desc: Period melodrama. John Wayne, Ray Milland and Paulette Goddard star in this tale of fierce rivalries engendered by love and seemingly deliberate shipwrecking in 19th-century Florida.

programs.title: Send Me No Flowers
programs.desc: Romcom starring Rock Hudson and Doris Day. Thinking he has just a few months to live, a man makes his wife suspect he's having an affair when he tries to find her a new partner.

programs.title: The Last Wagon
programs.desc: Western. Richard Widmark plays a man who murdered the killers of his wife and children and who becomes the unlikely saviour of a wagon train that's attacked by Apaches.

programs.title: Decision at Sundown
programs.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott and John Carroll. A man seeking revenge for his wife's death tracks his rival down in the sleepy town of Sundown..
